name: figma-naming-mcp
description: MCP server that checks and fixes Figma component/frame/property naming against a convention (component/frame: PascalCase, property: camelCase).

scripts.pack:plugin: npm run build:plugin && rm -rf figma-naming-plugin figma-naming-plugin.zip && mkdir -p figma-naming-plugin/dist && cp figma-plugin/manifest.json figma-plugin/ui.html figma-naming-plugin/ && cp figma-plugin/dist/code.js figma-naming-plugin/dist/ && zip -qr figma-naming-plugin.zip figma-naming-plugin && rm -rf figma-naming-plugin
